Round 292 fails: one Medium bug that this round introduced, **C-R292-01**. All 20 rows B specified pass, and every browser check ran in real Chromium, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. **C-R292-01: the library preview keeps playing behind the narrow screen.** - **Steps:** at 1440×900 or 1280×720, preview the `Bass` sound from the library, then narrow the window below 900 px. - **What happens:** the preview keeps sounding for its full length (about 0.1 RMS on the Studio output 10 s after the resize; silent only at 20 s). The narrow screen has only the built-in player and `Send link`, so nothing there stops it. Pressing that player's Play plays both sounds at once. - **Why it's new:** before this round the workspace stayed on screen at that width, so the preview's Stop button was still reachable. - **Cause:** the task told A to stop only the transport when the window narrows. A spotted the gap from the code but reported it as a note instead of a STOP. B needs to grant stopping the preview when the narrow screen appears, plus a test that fails without it. - **Evidence:** `c-round-292/c292.json` (rows `X-LIBRARY-PREVIEW` and `X-PREVIEW-LIFETIME`), `mix-probe.json`, and the `shots/libpreview-*.png` screenshots. **What I re-ran myself (passed):** - **Claims, scope and typecheck:** the claims script changed only where expected (one extra test file in K14, as A said). Exactly the 9 granted files changed, none of the 7 protected files was touched, and typecheck returned 0. - **Unit tests:** 8 files, 145 tests, all pass. The slowest uses 33 % of its timeout. - **Mutants:** all 9 turn a test red. A was right that the "server snapshot false" mutant is caught by NG9c, not NG3. - **Browser, narrow window:** - Loads at 390, 768 and 899 px show the narrow screen with nothing focused. - The 899/900 px boundary works with JavaScript on and off. - Colours are the Obsidian theme, with contrast 15.6:1 for the heading and 7.1:1 for the body line. - The accessibility tree and Tab order are correct. - The preview player shows 1:41 before Play and advances 1 s per second. - All four `Send link` cases behave as specified, and so does the broken-audio case. - **Browser, resizing:** - Narrowing a playing Studio silences the output within 100 ms. - The work survives narrowing and widening at both viewports: clip count, mute state and Undo history. - Space and Delete do nothing while the narrow screen shows. - Focus moves correctly both ways. - **Desktop and journey:** - The desktop screen is pixel-identical to before at 1280×720 and 1440×900. - The phone journey works: home → menu → Studio → copy link → back home. - Premium sign-in is not bypassed: the paid Studio route still asks for sign-in, and the token API refuses requests without a token. - **Doc 218:** passes. - No hydration warning appeared at any width. **Notes for B:** - B-RESIZE-KEEP's recipe mutes the lane the new clip lands on, so its "silent within 300 ms" check proves nothing as written. I measured it with the lane unmuted instead. - Doc 218's status line already says `Completed (C round 292 PASS)`. It must be rewritten in the fix-up round. - A's other deviations (D1 `` instead of `

`, the K14 change, and the jsdom-only warning that never showed in Chromium) are written up for B to acknowledge. - Ableton conformity: not applicable, because Live has no browser version. I made no source edits. The tree still shows only A's 9 files. Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`: the report is `c-round-292.md`, the JSON is `c-round-292.json` (with `envStatus` copied in), and the evidence is in `c-round-292/`.
